steps.id: Didihkan air dalam panci kecil.
steps.en: Bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan.
steps.zh: 在小锅中把水烧开。

steps.id: Masukkan jahe, lalu rebus perlahan selama 5 menit.
steps.en: Add the ginger and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
steps.zh: 加入生姜，小火煮5分钟。

steps.id: Tuang ke cangkir dan tambahkan madu bila suka.
steps.en: Pour into cups and stir in honey if desired.
steps.zh: 倒入杯中，喜欢的话加入蜂蜜。

steps.id: Panaskan minyak dalam wajan dengan api sedang-besar.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
steps.zh: 炒锅中火加热食用油。

steps.id: Masukkan jahe dan bawang putih, tumis 30 detik, lalu masukkan paprika dan brokoli; tumis 4 menit.
steps.en: Add ginger and garlic; stir-fry for 30 seconds, then add the pepper and broccoli and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
steps.zh: 加入生姜和大蒜炒30秒，再加入甜椒和西兰花炒4分钟。

steps.id: Tambahkan tahu dan kecap asin; aduk perlahan dan masak 5 menit hingga brokoli hijau cerah dan masih renyah serta tahu panas merata.
steps.en: Add tofu and soy sauce; toss gently and cook for 5 minutes, until the broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp and the tofu is hot throughout.
steps.zh: 加入豆腐和酱油，轻轻翻炒5分钟，直到西兰花颜色鲜亮、口感爽脆，豆腐也完全热透。

steps.id: Sajikan dengan nasi.
steps.en: Serve with rice.
steps.zh: 搭配米饭食用。

steps.id: Campur beras, air, kunyit, dan garam dalam panci; aduk sekali.
steps.en: Combine the rice, water, turmeric and salt in a saucepan; stir once.
steps.zh: 将米、水、姜黄粉和盐放入锅中，搅拌一次。

steps.id: Masukkan daun pandan, tutup, lalu didihkan.
steps.en: Add the pandan leaf, cover and bring to a boil.
steps.zh: 加入香兰叶，盖上锅盖煮沸。

steps.id: Kecilkan api dan masak tertutup selama 15 menit; diamkan 10 menit di luar api, lalu aduk perlahan dan sajikan.
steps.en: Turn heat to low and cook covered for 15 minutes; rest off heat for 10 minutes, then fluff and serve.
steps.zh: 转小火盖盖煮15分钟；离火焖10分钟，再把米饭拨松后食用。

text.id: 1 buah apel sedang, buang biji dan iris

steps.id: Masukkan apel, kayu manis, dan air ke panci.
steps.en: Put the apple, cinnamon and water in a saucepan.
steps.zh: 将苹果、肉桂和水放入锅中。

steps.id: Didihkan, lalu tutup dan rebus perlahan selama 12 menit.
steps.en: Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 12 minutes.
steps.zh: 煮沸后盖上锅盖，小火煮12分钟。

steps.id: Saring ke mug dan sajikan hangat.
steps.en: Strain into mugs and serve warm.
steps.zh: 过滤到马克杯中，趁热饮用。

steps.id: Cuci daun mint lalu masukkan ke teko tahan panas.
steps.en: Rinse the mint leaves and place them in a heatproof pot.
steps.zh: 洗净薄荷叶，放入耐热壶中。

steps.id: Tuangkan air yang baru mendidih, tutup, dan seduh selama 5 menit.
steps.en: Pour over freshly boiled water, cover and steep for 5 minutes.
steps.zh: 倒入刚烧开的水，盖上盖子浸泡5分钟。

steps.id: Saring ke cangkir dan beri pemanis bila suka.
steps.en: Strain into cups and sweeten if desired.
steps.zh: 过滤到杯中，喜欢的话加些甜味。

steps.id: Panaskan minyak dalam panci, lalu tumis serai selama 2 menit.
steps.en: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the lemongrass for 2 minutes.
steps.zh: 锅中加热食用油，放入香茅炒2分钟。

steps.id: Tuang kaldu dan masukkan wortel; didihkan lalu rebus perlahan 12 menit hingga wortel mudah ditusuk garpu.
steps.en: Add the stock and carrot; bring to a boil, then simmer for 12 minutes until the carrot is tender when pierced.
steps.zh: 倒入高汤并加入胡萝卜，煮沸后小火煮12分钟，直到胡萝卜能轻松被筷子戳透。

steps.id: Masukkan tahu dan kecap asin; rebus perlahan 5 menit lalu sajikan panas.
steps.en: Add tofu and soy sauce; simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot.
steps.zh: 加入豆腐和酱油，小火煮5分钟，趁热享用。

steps.id: Cuci selada dan herba di bawah air mengalir lalu keringkan.
steps.en: Wash the lettuce and herbs under running water and dry them well.
steps.zh: 用流动水洗净生菜和香草，并充分沥干。

steps.id: Aduk air lemon, minyak zaitun, dan garam dalam mangkuk besar.
steps.en: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil and salt in a large bowl.
steps.zh: 在大碗中搅匀柠檬汁、橄榄油和盐。

steps.id: Masukkan sayuran dan herba, aduk perlahan, lalu segera sajikan.
steps.en: Add the vegetables and herbs, toss gently, and serve right away.
steps.zh: 加入蔬菜和香草轻轻拌匀，立即食用。

steps.id: Cuci selada dan herba di bawah air mengalir lalu keringkan.

steps.id: Aduk air lemon, minyak zaitun, dan garam dalam mangkuk besar.

steps.id: Campur daun jeruk, bawang putih, air jeruk nipis, kecap asin, dan garam; lumuri ayam lalu simpan di kulkas selama 20 menit.
steps.en: Mix lime leaves, garlic, lime juice, soy sauce and salt; coat the chicken and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
steps.zh: 将泰国柠檬叶、大蒜、青柠汁、酱油和盐拌匀，涂抹鸡肉后冷藏20分钟。

steps.id: Panaskan minyak di wajan dengan api sedang.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat.
steps.zh: 平底锅中火加热食用油。

steps.id: Masak ayam 6–8 menit per sisi, balik sekali, hingga kecokelatan dan bagian terdalam mencapai 74°C.
steps.en: Cook the chicken for 6–8 minutes per side, turning once, until browned and the thickest part reaches 74°C internally.
steps.zh: 鸡肉每面煎6–8分钟，中途翻面一次，直到表面金黄且最厚处内部温度达到74°C。

steps.id: Diamkan 3 menit, iris, lalu sajikan.
steps.en: Rest for 3 minutes, slice and serve.
steps.zh: 静置3分钟，切片后食用。

steps.id: Masukkan beras, air, dan garam ke panci lalu aduk sekali.
steps.en: Put rice, water and salt in a saucepan and stir once.
steps.zh: 将米、水和盐放入锅中，搅拌一次。

steps.id: Tambahkan daun pandan, tutup, dan didihkan.
steps.en: Add the pandan leaves, cover and bring to a boil.
steps.zh: 加入香兰叶，盖上锅盖煮沸。

steps.id: Kecilkan api dan masak tertutup selama 15 menit; diamkan 10 menit di luar api, buang daun, aduk perlahan, lalu sajikan.
steps.en: Lower the heat and cook covered for 15 minutes; rest off heat for 10 minutes, remove the leaves, fluff and serve.
steps.zh: 转小火盖盖煮15分钟；离火焖10分钟，取出香兰叶，拨松后食用。

steps.id: Rebus ayam dalam air selama 35 menit sambil membuang buih; pastikan bagian terdalam mencapai 74°C. Angkat ayam dan sisihkan kaldu.
steps.en: Simmer the chicken in the water for 35 minutes, skimming the broth; confirm the thickest part reaches 74°C. Remove the chicken and reserve the broth.
steps.zh: 将鸡肉放入水中小火煮35分钟并撇去浮沫；确认最厚处内部温度达到74°C。取出鸡肉，留下汤底。

steps.id: Haluskan bawang merah, bawang putih, kunyit, jahe, dan kemiri hingga menjadi bumbu.
steps.en: Blend the shallots, garlic, turmeric, ginger and candlenuts into a paste.
steps.zh: 把红葱头、大蒜、姜黄、生姜和烛果打成细腻的香料酱。

steps.id: Panaskan minyak dan tumis bumbu selama 5 menit sambil diaduk hingga harum dan agak keemasan.
steps.en: Heat the oil and fry the paste for 5 minutes, stirring, until fragrant and lightly golden.
steps.zh: 锅中加油，将香料酱炒5分钟，边炒边搅拌，直到香气出来并略呈金黄色。

steps.id: Masukkan bumbu, serai, dan daun jeruk ke kaldu; rebus perlahan selama 15 menit.
steps.en: Add the paste, lemongrass and lime leaves to the broth; simmer for 15 minutes.
steps.zh: 把香料酱、香茅和泰国柠檬叶加入汤底，小火煮15分钟。

steps.id: Suwir ayam, masukkan kembali ke kaldu, lalu rebus 5 menit. Sajikan di atas nasi dengan daun bawang.
steps.en: Shred the chicken, return it to the broth and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over rice with scallions.
steps.zh: 将鸡肉撕成细丝，放回汤中再煮5分钟。盛在米饭上，撒上小葱。

steps.id: Masukkan ke panci bersama air, lalu didihkan.
steps.en: Add them to a pot with the water and bring to a boil.

steps.id: Tutup dan rebus perlahan selama 30 menit; jika memakai gula batu, aduk hingga larut.
steps.en: Cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes; stir in rock sugar until dissolved if using.
steps.zh: 盖上锅盖小火煮30分钟；如使用冰糖，搅拌至融化。

steps.id: Sajikan hangat dalam mangkuk.
steps.en: Serve warm in bowls.
steps.zh: 盛入碗中趁热享用。

text.id: 300 g kurma merah kering, buang bijinya

steps.id: Cuci kurma, masukkan ke panci bersama air, lalu didihkan.
steps.en: Rinse the dates, place them in a saucepan with water and bring to a boil.
steps.zh: 洗净红枣，放入锅中加水煮沸。

steps.id: Tutup dan rebus perlahan selama 40 menit hingga kurma sangat lunak dan mudah hancur.
steps.en: Cover and simmer for 40 minutes, until the dates are very soft and split easily.
steps.zh: 盖上锅盖小火煮40分钟，直到红枣非常软、轻轻一压就散开。

steps.id: Tiriskan dan sisihkan 100 ml air rebusan; blender kurma dengan air lemon, lalu tambahkan air rebusan sedikit demi sedikit hingga halus.
steps.en: Drain, reserving 100 ml cooking liquid; blend dates with lemon juice and add reserved liquid a little at a time until smooth.
steps.zh: 沥干并留出100毫升煮枣水；将红枣和柠檬汁打成泥，再逐次加入留出的水，直到细滑。

steps.id: Dinginkan, tutup, dan simpan di kulkas; habiskan dalam 5 hari.
steps.en: Cool, cover and refrigerate; use within 5 days.
steps.zh: 放凉后加盖冷藏，并在5天内食用。

steps.id: Bilas bunga kering sebentar lalu masukkan ke teko.
steps.en: Rinse the dried flowers briefly and place them in a teapot.
steps.zh: 稍微冲洗干菊花后放入茶壶。

steps.id: Tuangkan air yang baru mendidih, tutup, dan seduh selama 5 menit.
steps.en: Pour in freshly boiled water, cover and steep for 5 minutes.
steps.zh: 倒入刚烧开的水，盖上盖子浸泡5分钟。

steps.id: Saring ke cangkir; tambahkan gula batu dan aduk hingga larut bila suka.
steps.en: Strain into cups; add rock sugar and stir until dissolved if desired.
steps.zh: 过滤到杯中；喜欢的话加入冰糖并搅拌至融化。

text.en: 100 g dried lotus seeds, soaked for 4 hours and drained

steps.id: Tiriskan biji teratai yang direndam, lalu rebus dalam air baru selama 15 menit hingga mudah ditusuk garpu; tiriskan.
steps.en: Drain the soaked lotus seeds and simmer them in fresh water for 15 minutes, until a fork pierces them easily; drain.
steps.zh: 沥干泡好的莲子，换清水小火煮15分钟，直到筷子能轻松戳透；沥干。

steps.id: Campur beras, biji teratai matang, air, dan garam dalam panci.
steps.en: Combine rice, cooked lotus seeds, water and salt in a saucepan.
steps.zh: 将米、煮好的莲子、水和盐放入锅中。

steps.id: Tutup dan didihkan, lalu masak dengan api kecil selama 15 menit. Diamkan tertutup 10 menit, aduk perlahan, dan sajikan.

steps.id: Campur tepung ketan dengan air hangat dan uleni 3 menit hingga adonan lembut dan tidak lengket; tutup selama 10 menit.
steps.en: Mix the rice flour with warm water and knead for 3 minutes into a soft, non-sticky dough; cover for 10 minutes.
steps.zh: 将糯米粉和温水混合，揉3分钟至柔软不粘手，盖好静置10分钟。

steps.id: Bagi menjadi 12 bola. Pipihkan, isi masing-masing sekitar 1 sdt pasta kacang merah, rapatkan, lalu bulatkan.
steps.en: Divide into 12 balls. Flatten each, add about 1 tsp red bean paste, seal and roll smooth.
steps.zh: 分成12份搓圆。每份压扁，放入约1茶匙红豆沙，收口后搓圆。

steps.id: Gulingkan setiap bola di wijen sambil ditekan ringan agar menempel.
steps.en: Roll each ball in sesame seeds, pressing lightly so they stick.
steps.zh: 把每个糯米球滚上白芝麻，轻轻按压让芝麻粘牢。
